title: Claude Code through Nexus Gateway
description: Set up Claude Code so every model call goes through Nexus Gateway on your organization's key, metered and recorded.
limits: This is the Gateway route. Every call goes through Nexus Gateway on your organization's Anthropic key: reserved, metered, checked against your organization's policy and attributed to you. Nexus credit never pays for it. Your own Claude plan is not used.
Plain `nexus claude`, with no route flag, runs on your own Claude plan instead, unless you saved another route. Every command below names `--api`.

Every call reserves the most it could cost before it is sent, and Claude Code asks for its model's full output limit. On a large model one call can reserve more than a small monthly limit has left, and Gateway refuses it with `402` before it runs. Name a smaller model with `--model`, or ask an owner or admin about your limit.

steps.text: Install the nexus CLI. It needs Node.js 22.6 or later and curl. If the installer says its folder is not on your PATH, add the line it prints to your shell's profile, then open a new terminal.
Install Claude Code. Nexus never installs it for you. If `claude` is not found afterwards, add `~/.local/bin` to your PATH.
Sign in to Nexus and approve the code in Nexus UI. The code expires after ten minutes.
If `nexus keys list` shows no Anthropic key, add the organization's key, once. Without a key, Gateway refuses the call with `403`.
Run one prompt through Gateway, on a small model so even a $1 monthly limit covers the call.
steps.command: nexus claude --api --model claude-haiku-5-5 -p "Reply with the single word pong"

verify.text: The call shows in your spend under `agents › claude`, and the session in Nexus UI.

features: One prompt through Gateway by the steps above, recorded in `nexus spend`

retireWhen: The launcher drops the Gateway route for Claude Code, or Claude Code stops taking a custom base URL.
